snippet.text: HasConeMargin ε p₁ p₂ A C := ε ≤ A ∧ ε ≤ A*(1+(C/A)^2) - 2 ∧ ε ≤ p₁ + p₂*(C/A) - 2 ∧ ε ≤ coneBound (p₁ + p₂*(C/A)) (p₂ - p₁*(C/A)) - A*(1+(C/A)^2) — a componentwise additive margin ε for the Lean's own four cone quantities. These four scalar functions are not the paper's Ψ_i: with a = A and b = −C (p. 41), so that p₁+p₂(C/A) = c and p₂−p₁(C/A) = j, the paper's (4.35) third and fourth components are c−v and 2(c−v)²−(v−2)j², while the Lean's third and fourth are c−2 and coneBound(c,j)−v. They cut out the same open set but a margin ε on one tuple is not a margin ε on the other
